gate.criterion: mean over val cases of measure-weighted rel-L2(Cp_pf, Cp_label) < 0.90

metric_space: recipe training space: Cp = (pMeanTrim - p_inf) / (0.5 rho_inf |U_inf|^2); weights = retained-cell areas (recipe metrics.py _relative_l2 with target_measure); points = recipe val subsample, sampling_resolution=10000, training.seed=42 (N1 npz, verified against full-resolution centroids)

method.geometry: physicsnemo.mesh.remeshing.remesh(vehicle, n_clusters) -> remove_degenerate_cells -> fix_orientation -> fill_holes(max 200 edges) -> drop open components -> outward orientation by signed volume -> drop enclosed components; watertightness = every edge shared by exactly 2 faces
method.operators: kernel_decoder.exact_double_layer_member / exact_single_layer_member (fp64, dense, chunked); own-panel double-layer entries via exterior_trace_self_entries (+1/2)
method.formulation: Morino exterior Neumann: (I - K_ext) phi = S [U_inf . n]; total Phi = U_inf . x + phi; u_t = tangential U_inf + P1 surface gradient of area-averaged vertex phi; Cp = 1 - |u_t|^2 / |U_inf|^2
method.ground: method of images across z = z_min(vehicle) - 2 mm (mirrored panels, reversed winding); reported with and without
method.wake: none (bluff body; no Kutta condition / lift-carrying wake sheet)
method.readout: eval points projected to the coarse surface via signed_distance_field (closest point, nearest face); primary Cp_pf from the representation formula u = U_inf + grad_x[K(x) phi + S(x) b] (autograd through the exact members) at the projected point pushed delta = 1 x mean panel size along the panel's outward normal (exterior point: no jump branch, no self entry); delta = 2h variant and on-surface gradient variants (nearest-panel LS gradient, barycentric, vertex-averaged P1) reported as secondary
